dog.description_text:
Introducing Tulip! Don't let her tiny size fool you—at just 6 months old and 15 pounds, Tulip has enough personality to fill an entire room! This adorable Chihuahua mix is on the hunt for a forever family that can keep up with her playful spirit and endless love for life. If there's one thing Tulip loves more than anything, it's water! Turn on the hose, fill up a kiddie pool, or let her splash through a sprinkler, and you've just created her version of paradise. She could happily spend hours chasing the stream of water, hopping through puddles, and cooling off in her favorite kiddie pool. Watching her play is guaranteed to put a smile on your face. After she's had her fill of fun, Tulip transforms into the sweetest cuddle bug. She'll happily curl up beside you on the couch for a well-earned nap, often drifting into the cutest puppy dreams. You'll find her snoozing with her little paws stretched into the air, her tongue peeking out, and tiny sleepy barks escaping every now and then. It's almost impossible not to stop what you're doing just to admire how adorable she is. Tulip is eager to learn and ready to take on every new adventure life has to offer. She promises to give training her very best effort—especially if treats are involved! Smart, curious, and always willing to please, she's the kind of puppy who will blossom with a little guidance, plenty of love, and lots of positive reinforcement. Whether you're heading out for an adventure or spending a quiet evening at home, Tulip is ready to be your loyal sidekick. If you're looking for a playful, affectionate little girl who will fill your days with laughter, cuddles, and a whole lot of splashing, Tulip is ready to make your family complete.

Tulip is spayed, microchipped, and up to date on her vaccinations. For more information about her, please fill out an application at www.ALRcares.com and email Kate@alrcares.com. We schedule meet and greets for approved adopters only, an application is the first step in our approval process. Thank you!
